description: None of the five context folders contain anything beyond (at most) the standing README template — no real financial, operational, market, technical, or people data is provided for a decision this size. Every subagent should have too little to go on.
notes: This is the one example where a fully empty context/<role>/ folder is staged for the run (the standing README.md is removed for the duration of the run and restored afterward), directly exercising each agent's literal instruction: 'if the folder is empty, return insufficient_data.'
